title: Add block move and rename mutations to MealPlan
description: Extend `MealPlan` with focused block-level mutation APIs for reordering and renaming top-level blocks, including safe index handling and heading trimming while preserving block contents.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlan.moveBlock(from:to:)` exists and does not trap on invalid indices.
`moveBlock` only changes block ordering and is a no-op when source and destination resolve to the same position.
`MealPlan.renameBlock(at:to:)` trims whitespace and updates only the target block heading.
Inner sections, item ordering, comments, and text remain unchanged by both mutations.
